description: collections_search — FamilySearch's OWN Massachusetts record collections, trimmed to the census-titled subset. Includes the two surviving state-census schedules FamilySearch hosts: Massachusetts, State Census, 1855 (1459985) and 1865 (1410399), plus the 1870/1880 federal mortality schedules. This is the FS-holdings side of the collections-fs-holdings test (issue #1313): it proves FamilySearch holds the same 1855 census the MyHeritage external link points at (external-links-search-massachusetts), so the skill can note the FS holding instead of recommending the competitor. Results are verbatim from a live collections_search('Massachusetts, United States') on 2026-08-10. Distinct from the shared collections-search-massachusetts fixture (vital/probate/church, no census) used by the locality-guide tests — do not confuse them.
